ours.label: Martian's offline board, read back. official, candidates and matches are Martian's pipeline's own (its extraction, dedup and judge, and score_profiles' totals), unchanged. ours is computed by script from those matches: golden comments found (distinct), findings behind a matched candidate (distinct), and each found golden comment's severity against the severity of the first finding in report order behind a candidate matched to it, on the scale critical, major, minor, nitpick, info (Critical critical, High major, Medium minor, Low nitpick). A board output, labelled with its judge; never an acceptance metric.

severity.label: Each found truth item once, by the first finding that hit it: the severity it gave against the truth item's, on the scale critical, major, minor, nitpick, info. Off is two steps or more; the matrix is truth severity, then given severity.

intervals.method: Percentile bootstrap over clusters drawn with replacement; each metric is a ratio of sums recomputed on every resample, and a cluster keeps all its truth items, findings and repeats together. A cluster with nothing to count for a metric is left out of it. The interval describes this run and decides nothing: the trend's alarm and the acceptance rule compare two runs with a paired sign-flip test. With fewer than minClusters clusters it is null, listed under tooFewClusters.
intervals.seed: mulberry32 seeded with the first 32 bits of sha256 over the run id, the configuration and the metric name, joined by NUL
